description: This file defines the `ScanResultAdapter` class, a custom adapter for displaying Bluetooth scan results in a list view within an Android application. It manages a list of `ScanResult` objects, providing methods to add, update, clear, and display scan results, including handling view recycling and formatting the elapsed time since the device was last seen.

classes.name: ScanResultAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to manage and display Bluetooth LE scan results in a list view.

methods.name: ScanResultAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing context, inflater, and the internal list for scan results.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of scan results currently stored.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves a scan result at a specific position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Provides a unique ID for a scan result based on device address hash code.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles a view to display a scan result, setting device name, address, and last seen time.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Searches for a device by address in the list and returns its position or -1 if not found.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new scan result or updates an existing one based on device address.

methods.name: getTimeSinceString
methods.description: Formats the elapsed time since a scan result was received into a human-readable string.
